harm_review.reason: A Cost Explorer interruption is established and Financial Times reports roughly thirteen hours. Amazon disputes autonomous AI causation and describes a limited human/access-role error. The actual operational consequence is preserved, but the occurrence-specific AI contribution and duration disagreement remain unresolved. Keep canonical S3 pending engineering change-authority/process trace, rather than silently rating whole-event harm as AI-attributed or withdrawing it for missing customer complaints.
harm_review.financial_alternative_criteria: Live ordering defects or Cost Explorer interruption do not establish actual financial loss. Both non-USD S2 low remediable economic disruption and S3 bounded livelihood/organisational loss were tested; specific realised economic endpoints are not preserved. No existing financial band withdrawn because an amount is unavailable.

fc_086_087_review.basis: Operational assistance, a named vending agent and customer support do not evidence an AI intimacy-bearing role, exclusive-care claim or unsupported real-world family/partner authority. No engaged escalation challenge and boundary-preserving continuation supports a success relationship.
fc_086_087_review.failure_test: No intimacy-bearing relational-authority assertion, real-world partner priority or material boundary distortion is evidenced.
fc_086_087_review.success_test: No material exclusive-role or relational escalation challenge and observed boundary-preserving response is evidenced.
fc_086_087_review.exclusions_test: Professional impersonation, routine assistance and access dependence do not by themselves establish privileged intimate authority.

fc_086_087_review.basis: No preserved interaction jointly establishes reasonably available developmental, impaired-consent, acute-distress or harmful-dependency signals, an independently applicable contemporaneous heightened personal duty and materially contradictory response. Service impairment or commercial dependency does not prove personal vulnerability or control nonactivation.
fc_086_087_review.failure_test: The independent context/person/time duty, sufficiently visible heightened-risk signals and materially omitted bounded response are not established together.
fc_086_087_review.success_test: Ordinary repair, refusal, seizure or human recovery is not evidence of an engaged heightened personal-protection duty being discharged by the AI.
fc_086_087_review.exclusions_test: Neither adverse consequences nor commercial dependency establish personal vulnerability. No available-control nonactivation is inferred from absence of protection.

evidence_search.notes: Fresh original company-quoted Restaurant Dive account and AP indexed report for the restaurant pilot; fresh Amazon statement and Financial Times indexed occurrence account for Cost Explorer. Complete original technical traces unavailable.

taxonomy_mapping_dispositions.reason: Press reporting associated the outage-triggering change with Kiro, while Amazon attributed the event to human error and access-control configuration; the causal mechanism therefore remains materially contested.
